description: Filters the catalog by caffeine, sugar, sweetener type, flavor family, carbonation and extras, with the same filters as energydrinkratings.com/find. Returns only available drinks, ranked by real community rating where rated, then by name, along with the total number of matches.

caffeine.description: Caffeine bands (OR'd together): le100 (≤100 mg), 100-199 (101–199 mg), 200-299 (200–299 mg), 300plus (300+ mg)

extras.description: Required ingredient tags (AND'd together): preworkout (Pre-workout), focus (Focus)

flavors.description: Flavor families (OR'd together): citrus (Citrus), berry (Berry), tropical (Tropical), stone_fruit (Stone Fruit), cherry (Cherry), grape (Grape), melon (Melon), apple_pear (Apple & Pear), fruit_punch (Fruit Punch), candy_dessert (Candy & Dessert), cola (Cola), root_beer_cream_soda (Root Beer & Cream Soda), coffee_tea (Coffee & Tea), original (Original)

sweetener.description: 'no-artificial' excludes artificial sweeteners; 'natural' requires a plant-based one (Plant-based sweeteners). Sweetener categories: sugar=Sugar, artificial=Artificial sweeteners, natural=Plant-based sweeteners

name: find_drinks
title: Find drinks matching criteria
